metadata.purpose: Roster plate, assignment, and secondary detail.

shadows.name: floating-calendar
shadows.purpose: Separates the desktop calendar from content below it; translated from native shadow properties.

breakpoints.name: calendar-inline
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width the reporting calendar opens in flow.

breakpoints.name: roster-columns
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width unit rows reorganize identity and assignment into two lines.

breakpoints.name: planner-columns
breakpoints.purpose: Show the map beside the trip planner.

breakpoints.name: web-navigation-rail
breakpoints.purpose: Show a labeled navigation rail in a wide web viewport.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main ordinary action in a form or journey.

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A quiet alternative beside the main action.

components.name: Emergency SOS
components.description: Starts the five-second cancellation timer before opening Messages.

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: A white input with a label and restrained border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Destination<input placeholder="Search a place, street, or landmark"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:#13263F;font:600 13px system-ui}.ds-field input{min-width:0;border:1px solid #CCD4DD;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#13263F;padding:12px 13px;font:400 15px system-ui}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#526174}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#526174}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #13263F;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Working panel
components.description: Groups one coherent task without raised decoration.

components.name: Selected roster filter
components.description: Selection uses a charcoal border on white.

components.name: Fleet ledger row
components.description: Unit identity and current facts remain visible; shift detail expands on demand.
components.css: .ds-roster{border-bottom:1px solid #CCD4DD;background:#fff;color:#13263F;padding:14px 16px;font:400 14px/20px system-ui}.ds-roster summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-roster summary>span:first-child{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-roster strong{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-roster small{display:block;color:#526174;font:400 12px/18px system-ui}.ds-count{text-align:right;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-status{color:#526174;font-size:12px}.ds-roster>div{border-top:1px solid #CCD4DD;margin-top:12px;padding-top:16px}.ds-roster summary:hover{opacity:.86}.ds-roster summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #13263F;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Activity tabs
components.description: A single selected category with an ink underline over a shared baseline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Safety activity"><button aria-current="page">Driver grades</button><button>Speed events</button><button>Route flags</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:24px;overflow-x:auto;border-bottom:1px solid #CCD4DD}.ds-tabs button{flex-shrink:0;min-height:44px;padding:0 2px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:#526174;font:500 14px system-ui;cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-current]{border-bottom-color:#13263F;color:#13263F}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:#13263F}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #13263F;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Bottom navigation
components.description: White navigation with charcoal active text and muted inactive text.

components.name: Reporting period
components.description: The current period stays visible; the calendar opens on demand.
components.css: .ds-period{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #CCD4DD;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#526174;font:600 12px system-ui}.ds-period strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#13263F;font-size:15px;font-weight:700}.ds-period button{min-height:44px;border:1px solid #CCD4DD;border-radius:12px;padding:0 11px;background:#fff;color:#13263F;font:700 12px system-ui;cursor:pointer}.ds-period button:hover{opacity:.86}.ds-period button:active{opacity:.7}.ds-period button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #13263F;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: The official logo and a role label anchor the navy header. Passenger journeys, driver shifts and supervisor operations share labeled navigation and clear availability states.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow planner heading and selected desktop tab
Labeled mobile tabs and desktop rail

rules.name: Service status
rules.body: Pair color with text for safety, GPS quality and unavailable data.

dos: Keep the next action and its requirements together.
Preserve measured and verified service data.
donts: Avoid decorative figures that resemble real service information.
